title: Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans

title: Meet the Nvidia Board Members Who Will Decide Jensen Huang’s Fate
summary: The intertwined fates of the world’s most valuable company, Nvidia, and its embattled CEO and co-founder, Jensen Huang, now lie in the hands of a group of Nvidia directors that includes early investors in the company, a one-time Goldman Sachs executive and a professor who’s an expert on how sea creatures swim.There may be no more consequential voice in the decision about Huang’s fate than that of Stephen Neal, a storied attorney who joined the board in 2019 and serves as its lead independent director. As chair of the Nvidia board’s corporate governance committee, he’s likely to take a leading role in the investigation. Neal is a longtime fixture at Cooley LLP, one of the nation’s most prominent corporate law firms. Among his prior clients is Elizabeth Holmes, the former Theranos founder and CEO, who is now in prison.
title_es: Directivos de NVIDIA decidirán futuro de Jensen Huang
bajada: La junta directiva de NVIDIA, incluyendo abogado prominente Stephen Neal, investigará las acusaciones contra CEO Jensen Huang. El resultado tendrá consecuencias enormes para la empresa valuada en billones.
bajada_en: NVIDIA's board, including prominent attorney Stephen Neal, will investigate allegations against CEO Jensen Huang. The outcome carries enormous consequences for the trillion-dollar company.

bajada_en: OpenAI integrated ChatGPT Enterprise into AWS Marketplace to streamline purchasing through existing billing relationships. This move simplifies enterprise adoption by aligning with familiar procurement workflows.

title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
summary: Learn how OpenAI’s Control Room tracks model workloads across our research infrastructure and can rapidly stop them when safety or security concerns arise.

bajada_en: OpenAI unveiled Control Room, a central system that tracks and can halt model workloads across its research infrastructure. The tool is critical for rapidly responding to security and safety concerns.

title: There Are Likely More Spies at AI Companies, Says Security Executive Lisa Thiergart
summary: Other countries likely haven’t yet stolen AI models from leading U.S. companies—but only for a lack of trying, said Lisa Thiergart, co-founder and CEO of Security Level 5, a startup that works with AI companies and the intelligence community to secure AI data centers. “If a nation state really wanted to steal the weights right now, they could. However, I think that they have cheaper ways to get what they need,” she said on the latest episode of AI Deep Dive. (The full episodeis available here.)The episode was recorded shortly after OpenAI accused one of its employees, a Saudi national, of hiding a recording device in an office conference room. In the interview, Thiergart said it is “pretty likely” that there are other spies in U.S. AI companies—a suspicion buttressed by recent reports from the New York Times and the Financial Times that some U.S. officials believed Nvidia CEO Jensen Huanghad a romantic relationshipwith a Chinese businesswoman recruited as a spy by China’s top intelligence agency.
title_es: Experto advierte sobre posibles espías en empresas de IA
bajada: Lisa Thiergart, CEO de Security Level 5, advierte que probablemente hay espías en empresas de IA estadounidenses intentando acceder a datos críticos. Las agencias de inteligencia buscan explotar vulnerabilidades de seguridad en data centers.
bajada_en: Lisa Thiergart, CEO of Security Level 5, warns that spies likely exist in U.S. AI companies seeking critical data access. Intelligence agencies are seeking to exploit security vulnerabilities in AI data centers.

bajada_en: NVIDIA and partners present advances in robotic simulation focused on delicate manipulation tasks like gear alignment. The focus complements earlier locomotion research with precision manual work.
